outcome: proportion of maternally requested elective inductions
factors associated with maternally requested elective inductions
factors associated with unrequested elective inductions
cohort: The study included approximately 14,681 women from a representative sample of births in the 2010 French National Perinatal Survey.
finding: The overall induction rate was 22.6%, with 13.9% being elective, and among these elective inductions, 47.3% were requested by women, with parity and private hospital status identified as key associated factors.
mod_finding: The study found that 13.9% of births were elective inductions, with 47.3% of these being maternally requested, and identified parity and private hospital status as factors influencing the decision for elective induction.
cross-section timing: Data collected from the 2010 French National Perinatal Survey.
